item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Since it seem like you really want to improve, I thought I would give you some info on what I noticed upon first glance:

  • There's some formatting issues with the image clipping into the top bar.
  • Capitalizing the words "containment breach".
  • The huge amount of blinding blackboxes (I suggest you read this document to use them in a more pertinent way.)
  • Calling everything "massive."
  • Calling everything "proven." (Both of these things are fine, but they are written repetitively, imo.)
  • The D-Class having weirdly casual behavior.
  • The lack of a narrative (you have an MTF shoot at it and nothing happens, that's about it for story.)

It's basically an object that does a thing with a bit of "gore for the sake of gore" thrown in for flavor, I suggest you take this idea back to the drawing board and visit the Ideas Critique Forum before posting again and I highly encourage you to follow through the process of feedback and criticism to make a better anomaly the next time.
Can somebody please tell me what's wrong with SCP? I would like to try to improve and I don't see any mistakes in spelling, grammar, and word formating. Thanks in advance.
